Label directions 'Take two capsules daily'; caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult'. Same amounts in scratchpad labels/labels.json (R178 / R178L) and in the products DB R178 (CellCore chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Sizes R178 60C and R178L 120C (ND144 price list 10/1/26, via labels.json). DOSE: NutriDyn's KBMO Mycotoxin Protocol ND1610 (Dropbox id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA7SJg, opened 2026-11-03): 'Take 2 capsules twice daily.' TIMING: every NutriDyn educator mold grid puts the binder at Mid Morning and Mid Evening, apart from the breakfast and supper supplements (Mold Care ~ Preparation Plan 'BinderPro 1-2 / 1-2'; Drive 1vklZwAc9lQvq1KyhQG8lTFdW4_kmdAF-, layout text read 2026-11-03), hence 'mid-morning, mid-evening' on the dose bar and in the rhythm, with the check panel's rule (2 hours apart from food, other supplements and every medicine). The rhythm panel has no mid-evening box, so the second dose sits in Bedtime with its real time written on it. mo_gi_defend.name: GI Defend
mo_gi_defend.key: 2.5 g ImmunoLin serum‑derived bovine immunoglobulin protein isolate per scoop
mo_gi_defend.src: Label: GI Defend sell sheet ND850 Rev. 12/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/GI Defend SS ND850.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAtQGg), opened by the mold agent 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts: serving size about 1 scoop (2.5 g), about 30 servings; calories 10, protein 2 g; Bovine Immunoglobulin Protein Isolate (ImmunoLin) 2.5 g; other ingredients none. Directions 'Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water or your favorite beverage'. Claims used: 'Supports healthy gut barrier function'; 'works by binding, neutralizing, and removing toxins from the gut'. Products DB R191 agrees (2.5 g ImmunoLin per scoop; size R191 75G). PROTOCOL: KBMO Mycotoxin Protocol ND1610 lists GI Defend ('binding, neutralizing, and removing gut toxins'; '2 scoops ... once daily'); the sheet prints the label's 1 scoop and leaves a higher dose to the practitioner. It is not called a binder on the sheet (the 2-hour spacing rule is Binder Pro's alone); Asher's email to a practice, Gmail 18c8d4ce4f783847, 2023-12-21, says it 'stays in the gut'. TIMING: before breakfast, from NutriDyn's '60 Day Gut Repair and Detox' protocol doc (Drive 1FFrFbiCARIDBfjEe0Hz6PETMvWnZM7IiIRcoXPidIZY, read 2026-11-03: GI Defend, 'Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water ...', When to take 'Before Breakfast'), which also keeps it away from both Binder Pro doses (mid-morning, mid-evening); no time of day is printed on the label or in ND1610. Photo: img-src/R191.png is a soft 4x stopgap (needs the print master). URL: products.py SLUGS gi_defend (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc).

Supplement Facts, serving 2 tablets, 90 servings: Artichoke Extract (aerial parts) 400 mg; Dandelion Extract (root) 250 mg; Beet Powder (root) 200 mg; Inositol 150 mg; Tangerine Extract (peel) 100 mg (printed as 'tangerine'); Gentian Extract (root; Gentiana scabra) 100 mg; Taurine 100 mg; L-Methionine 100 mg. Claims used: 'Promote healthy bile processes', 'Promote healthy liver function'; the sheet says artichoke and beet are choleretic and cholagogue, dandelion, tangerine and gentian cholagogue. Same panel in scratchpad labels/labels.json R863; the products DB R863 (CellCore charts) gives six of the eight amounts. Size R863 180T (ND144 price list 10/1/26). PROTOCOL: NutriDyn educator, Mold Care ~ Preparation Plan 'Lipo-Flow 1-3 breakfast, 1-3 supper' and Common Base Plan '1-2 / 1-2'; her key maps 'Biliary Efflux Support' to Lipo-Flow (Drive 1vklZwAc9lQvq1KyhQG8lTFdW4_kmdAF-, 1zYCDH9AotCvBWj6GT4IMpPAC3U6l5cPj). The sheet's 2 tablets with breakfast and supper (4 a day) sits inside the label's 6 a day and the educator's grid. Stands in for the competitor's bitter-herb (gentian, artichoke) and bile columns: NutriDyn's official match for bile formulas (Core Level Bile, GB-Plus, Lipo-Gen, LV-GB Complex in the switch charts). Mold-owned key, so the shared lipo_flow line other sheets print is unchanged. Photo: img-src/R863.png is a soft 4x stopgap (needs the print master). URL: products.py SLUGS lipo_flow.

Supplement Facts: serving 1 dropper (1 mL), 60 servings; L-Glutathione (reduced) 100 mg. Other ingredients: purified water, vegetable glycerin, natural strawberry watermelon flavor, non-GMO sunflower lecithin, stevia leaf extract, organic cane alcohol. Directions 'Shake well. Products DB R2188 agrees on five chart reads (100 mg per 1 mL). Size R2188 60 mL (ND144 price list 10/1/26). PROTOCOL: NutriDyn educator, Mycotoxin Exposure/History - Prep for Mold Plan 'Glutathione/NAC* 1 breakfast, 1 supper' with the asterisk '*Awareness of Gliotoxin risks and Glutathione'; 'Glutathione' is also in her BioToxins/Mycotoxins checklist (Drive 1vklZwAc9lQvq1KyhQG8lTFdW4_kmdAF-). NutriDyn KBMO MIP Protocol ND1577: 'Liposomal Glutathione one full dropper (1 mL) twice daily'. Chosen over NAC-600 because Mito Recharge on the same sheet already carries 100 mg NAC. Twice daily sits inside the label's 2 to 4 times. 'Shake well' is on the label and stays on the bottle; it is off the dose bar for room. mo_mito.src: Label: Mito Recharge sell sheet ND812 Rev. 2/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Mito Recharge SS ND812.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAvs1Q), opened by the mold agent 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts, serving 3 capsules, 30 servings: vitamin C 150 mg, vitamin E 25 mg, vitamin K1 (as phytonadione) 250 mcg, thiamin 25 mg, riboflavin 12 mg, niacin 12 mg NE, vitamin B6 (P5P) 7.5 mg, magnesium 75 mg, selenium 25 mcg, taurine 300 mg, acetyl-L-carnitine HCl 200 mg, resveratrol 100 mg, coenzyme Q10 100 mg, N-acetyl-L-cysteine 100 mg, EGCG (green tea extract) 100 mg, quercetin 100 mg, alpha-lipoic acid 75 mg, R-alpha-lipoic acid 45 mg, sulforaphane glucosinolate 15 mg, hydroxytyrosol 10 mg, PQQ 7 mg, mixed tocopherols 0.5 mg.
